title: 测试与验证
html:
测试与验证

核心概念

游戏 AI 行为的测试面临独特挑战：AI 的输出是行为序列而非返回值，「正确性」依赖于上下文，行为可能存在合理的随机性。有效的 BT 测试策略分三层：单元测试验证单个节点和子树的逻辑；集成测试在仿真环境中验证完整 AI 行为；录制回放捕获并重现 Bug。

graph TD
    T[BT 测试策略] --> U[单元测试\n节点/子树]
    T --> I[集成测试\n完整 AI 行为]
    T --> R[录制回放\n捕获/重现 Bug]
    U --> U1[Mock Blackboard\n隔离依赖]
    I --> I1[仿真环境\n确定性时间]
    R --> R1[快照对比\n回归检测]
测试层 覆盖范围 执行速度 可靠性 主要用途
单元测试 单节点/子树 极快（毫秒） 高（确定性） 节点逻辑正确性
集成测试 完整 AI 场景 中（秒） 中（依赖仿真） 行为场景验收
录制回放 Bug 重现 快 高（精确重现） Bug 修复验证
回归测试 历史 Bug 中 高 防止退化

单元测试 BT 节点与子树

单元测试的核心是隔离：使用 Mock Blackboard 注入控制数据，不依赖真实游戏对象：

// Mock Blackboard：可注入任意键值对
class MockBlackboard implements Blackboard {
  private store = new Map<string, unknown>();
  private observers = new Map<string, Array<(n: unknown, o: unknown) => void>>();

  inject<T>(key: BlackboardKey<T>, value: T, agentId = 'test'): void {
    this.store.set(`${agentId}:${key.name}`, value);
  }

  get<T>(key: BlackboardKey<T>, agentId = 'test'): T | undefined {
    return this.store.get(`${agentId}:${key.name}`) as T | undefined;
  }

  set<T>(key: BlackboardKey<T>, value: T, agentId = 'test'): void {
    const fullKey = `${agentId}:${key.name}`;
    const prev = this.store.get(fullKey);
    this.store.set(fullKey, value);
    this.observers.get(fullKey)?.forEach((cb) => cb(value, prev));
  }

  observe<T>(key: BlackboardKey<T>, agentId: string, cb: (n: T, o: T) => void) {
    const fullKey = `${agentId}:${key.name}`;
    if (!this.observers.has(fullKey)) this.observers.set(fullKey, []);
    this.observers.get(fullKey)!.push(cb as (n: unknown, o: unknown) => void);
    return { unsubscribe: () => {} };
  }
}

// 单元测试示例（使用 Vitest/Jest）
describe('ConditionIsInRange', () => {
  it('当敌人在范围内时返回 SUCCESS', () => {
    const bb = new MockBlackboard();
    const agentId = 'test_agent';
    bb.inject(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, 5, agentId);

    const condition = new ConditionIsInRange(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, 10);
    expect(condition.tick(bb, agentId)).toBe(NodeStatus.SUCCESS);
  });

  it('当敌人超出范围时返回 FAILURE', () => {
    const bb = new MockBlackboard();
    bb.inject(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, 15, 'test_agent');

    const condition = new ConditionIsInRange(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, 10);
    expect(condition.tick(bb, 'test_agent')).toBe(NodeStatus.FAILURE);
  });

  it('当键不存在时返回 FAILURE（防御性）', () => {
    const bb = new MockBlackboard(); // 未注入任何数据
    const condition = new ConditionIsInRange(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, 10);
    expect(condition.tick(bb, 'test_agent')).toBe(NodeStatus.FAILURE);
  });
});

describe('SequenceNode', () => {
  it('全部子节点 SUCCESS 时返回 SUCCESS', () => {
    const bb = new MockBlackboard();
    const seq = new SequenceNode([
      createMockNode(NodeStatus.SUCCESS),
      createMockNode(NodeStatus.SUCCESS),
      createMockNode(NodeStatus.SUCCESS),
    ]);
    expect(seq.tick(bb, 'test')).toBe(NodeStatus.SUCCESS);
  });

  it('任意子节点 FAILURE 时立即返回 FAILURE，跳过后续节点', () => {
    const mockNodes = [
      createMockNode(NodeStatus.SUCCESS),
      createMockNode(NodeStatus.FAILURE),
      createSpyNode(), // 不应被执行
    ];
    const seq = new SequenceNode(mockNodes);
    const bb = new MockBlackboard();

    expect(seq.tick(bb, 'test')).toBe(NodeStatus.FAILURE);
    expect((mockNodes[2] as SpyNode).wasExecuted).toBe(false);
  });

  it('RUNNING 节点在下一 tick 从正确位置恢复', () => {
    const bb = new MockBlackboard();
    let callCount = 0;
    const asyncNode = {
      tick: () => {
        callCount++;
        return callCount < 3 ? NodeStatus.RUNNING : NodeStatus.SUCCESS;
      },
    };

    const seq = new SequenceNode([createMockNode(NodeStatus.SUCCESS), asyncNode, createMockNode(NodeStatus.SUCCESS)]);

    expect(seq.tick(bb, 'test')).toBe(NodeStatus.RUNNING); // 第 1 帧
    expect(seq.tick(bb, 'test')).toBe(NodeStatus.RUNNING); // 第 2 帧
    expect(seq.tick(bb, 'test')).toBe(NodeStatus.SUCCESS); // 第 3 帧完成
    expect(callCount).toBe(3);
  });
});

集成测试：仿真环境中验证 AI 行为

集成测试在最小化的游戏仿真中运行完整 BT，验证 AI 在具体场景中的行为：

class AIBehaviorTestEnvironment {
  private time = 0;
  private agentPosition = new Vector3(0, 0, 0);
  private enemyPosition: Vector3 | null = null;
  private agentHealth = 100;
  private actions: string[] = []; // 记录执行过的行动

  // 推进仿真时间（确定性，不依赖真实时钟）
  tick(deltaTime: number): void {
    this.time += deltaTime;
  }

  spawnEnemy(position: Vector3): void {
    this.enemyPosition = position;
  }

  removeEnemy(): void {
    this.enemyPosition = null;
  }

  recordAction(actionName: string): void {
    this.actions.push(actionName);
  }

  getActionHistory(): string[] {
    return [...this.actions];
  }

  buildBlackboard(): Blackboard {
    const bb = new MockBlackboard();
    bb.inject(Keys.SELF_POSITION, this.agentPosition, 'agent_0');
    bb.inject(Keys.AGENT_HEALTH, this.agentHealth, 'agent_0');
    if (this.enemyPosition) {
      bb.inject(Keys.TARGET_POSITION, this.enemyPosition, 'agent_0');
      bb.inject(Keys.IS_ENEMY_VISIBLE, true, 'agent_0');
      bb.inject(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, Vector3.distance(this.agentPosition, this.enemyPosition), 'agent_0');
    } else {
      bb.inject(Keys.IS_ENEMY_VISIBLE, false, 'agent_0');
      bb.inject(Keys.ENEMY_DISTANCE, 999, 'agent_0');
    }
    return bb;
  }
}

describe('GuardAI 集成测试', () => {
  it('看到敌人时应切换到战斗行为', () => {
    const env = new AIBehaviorTestEnvironment();
    const bt = buildGuardBT();

    // 初始状态：巡逻
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      bt.tick(env.buildBlackboard(), 'agent_0');
      env.tick(1 / 60);
    }
    expect(env.getActionHistory().every((a) => a === 'patrol')).toBe(true);

    // 敌人出现
    env.spawnEnemy(new Vector3(5, 0, 0));
    env.getActionHistory().length = 0; // 清空历史

    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      bt.tick(env.buildBlackboard(), 'agent_0');
      env.tick(1 / 60);
    }

    // 应该有移动和攻击行为
    expect(env.getActionHistory()).toContain('move_to_attack_position');
    expect(env.getActionHistory()).toContain('attack');
  });

  it('敌人消失时应回到巡逻状态', () => {
    const env = new AIBehaviorTestEnvironment();
    env.spawnEnemy(new Vector3(5, 0, 0));
    const bt = buildGuardBT();

    // 先进入战斗
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      bt.tick(env.buildBlackboard(), 'agent_0');
      env.tick(1 / 60);
    }

    // 敌人消失
    env.removeEnemy();
    env.getActionHistory().length = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      bt.tick(env.buildBlackboard(), 'agent_0');
      env.tick(1 / 60);
    }

    expect(env.getActionHistory()).toContain('patrol');
    expect(env.getActionHistory()).not.toContain('attack');
  });
});

录制回放与回归测试

录制回放系统捕获运行时的完整状态序列，用于 Bug 重现和回归检测：

interface FrameSnapshot {
  frame: number;
  timestamp: number;
  blackboardState: Record<string, unknown>;
  btState: Record<string, NodeStatus | null>;
  inputEvents: string[];
}

class BTRecorder {
  private frames: FrameSnapshot[] = [];
  private recording = false;

  startRecording(): void {
    this.frames = [];
    this.recording = true;
  }

  captureFrame(
    frameNum: number,
    blackboard: Blackboard,
    btDebugData: Map<string, NodeDebugInfo>,
    agentId: string,
  ): void {
    if (!this.recording) return;

    this.frames.push({
      frame: frameNum,
      timestamp: performance.now(),
      blackboardState: blackboard.serialize()[agentId] ?? {},
      btState: Object.fromEntries(Array.from(btDebugData.entries()).map(([id, info]) => [id, info.status])),
      inputEvents: [],
    });
  }

  stopRecording(): FrameSnapshot[] {
    this.recording = false;
    return [...this.frames];
  }

  saveToFile(filePath: string): void {
    const data = JSON.stringify(this.frames, null, 2);
    writeFileSync(filePath, data);
  }
}

// 基于录制数据的回归测试
describe('回归测试：Issue #1234 - 敌人死亡后警卫仍追击', () => {
  it('敌人死亡后 BT 应该退出追击 Sequence', () => {
    const recording = JSON.parse(readFileSync('./recordings/bug_1234.json', 'utf-8')) as FrameSnapshot[];

    // 找到敌人死亡的帧
    const enemyDeathFrame = recording.findIndex((f) => f.blackboardState['enemy_alive'] === false);

    expect(enemyDeathFrame).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // 死亡后的帧中不应再有 attack 节点为 RUNNING
    const framesAfterDeath = recording.slice(enemyDeathFrame + 1, enemyDeathFrame + 11);
    for (const frame of framesAfterDeath) {
      expect(frame.btState['node_attack']).not.toBe(NodeStatus.RUNNING);
    }
  });
});

小结

  • BT 测试三层策略：单元测试（节点逻辑）→ 集成测试（行为场景）→ 录制回放（Bug 重现）
  • Mock Blackboard 是单元测试的核心：隔离游戏依赖，注入精确控制的输入数据
  • 测试 RUNNING 状态的节点需要多帧 tick，验证状态恢复位置是否正确
  • 集成测试环境应使用确定性时间（手动推进 deltaTime），避免时序不确定性
  • 录制回放格式应包含 Blackboard 快照和 BT 节点状态，便于重现和分析
  • 将已修复 Bug 的录制文件作为回归测试用例，防止同类问题复发
